name: letzscan
description: Open-source platform for exploring Luxembourg public data, live conditions, places and trends.

scripts.data:snapshot: uv run --directory pipeline letzscan publish statec-lustat --out ../apps/web/public/data --since 2024
scripts.data:publish: uv run --directory pipeline letzscan publish statec-lustat --out ../.out/published
scripts.py:lint: uv run --directory pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory pipeline ruff format --check .
scripts.verify:js: npm run check:secrets && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run schemas:check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:py: npm run py:lint && npm run py:test && npm run catalog:validate
scripts.verify: npm run verify:js && npm run verify:py
